issue_summary.TRUTH_CHECK: The mapping incorrectly treats technical replicates (the _1, _2, _3, _4 suffixes in the filenames) as separate fractions. According to the definition, repeated runs of the same material are technical replicates, not fractions. Each fraction (ECM/INSOL, FR1, FR2, FR3) should have its own index, and all runs of that fraction should share that index.
issue_summary.COMPLETENESS_CHECK: The mapping is logically incorrect based on the field definition.
